patterns.note: A flexible grid system is used to present product listings and editorial content, often featuring full-width hero images or multi-column layouts for articles and curated selections.

A sophisticated typographic hierarchy combines a high-contrast, elegant serif font for prominent headings and display text with a clean, legible sans-serif for body copy, product details, and navigation.

The primary color palette is monochromatic (black and white), allowing vibrant product photography to provide the main visual interest, with a striking red used sparingly for sale indicators and accents.
A sticky header navigation remains fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, and a prominent promotional modal appears on page load, overlaying the hero section.

The homepage intersperses curated product grids ('New In', 'Shop the Look') with rich editorial features ('Jodie Comer', 'NET-A-PORTER Live') and lifestyle content ('What to pack for your vacation'), creating a magazine-like browsing experience.

technique_notes: A persistent header navigation is implemented to stick to the top of the viewport, ensuring key site links and search are always accessible. A full-screen promotional modal is triggered on page load, using CSS keyframes for its appearance, requiring user interaction to dismiss it before accessing the main content.

Full-bleed, high-resolution photography is central to the design, used for hero sections and editorial blocks, often serving as a backdrop for elegant text overlays. Product displays are presented in clean, minimal grids with subtle hover effects on items.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) for editorial sections, with smaller, clean sans-serif for body text and product details.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced, with generous vertical spacing in editorial sections and tighter grids for product displays.

standout: The site masterfully blends high-fashion editorial content with a retail experience, using large, impactful photography and sophisticated typography to create a luxurious, magazine-like feel that elevates product browsing beyond a typical e-commerce site.
